scope: Read-only architecture review of seven pinned PR heads, their submitted official test records, and three bounded actual cross-trades. No source improvements or provider/model substitution.

verification.submitted_official_records: All eight participants contain 21 passing results, matching current kit SHA and each submission's agent.json commands; this is artifact consistency, not a fresh execution of eight suites.
verification.actual_cross_trades: Three completed lamp/budget120 trades, one per direction/pairing; not a full seven-opponent tournament.

compatibility: Basic integer-price trades are structurally compatible; that alone does not guarantee transaction success.
PR291 advanced quotes use DataPart product/ask; our quotes use message metadata itemId/ask/attributes. The expanded product contract is not interchangeable.
Description-based requests against PR296/295/291 lack our expected itemId mapping and can trigger strict product evidence rejection.
PR295/291 require integer strings. PR289/290 integer-token parsers can misread decimal representations, as isolated function/pattern checks confirm; not a failure observed in our three actual trades.
Our buyer does not handle pending SUBMITTED/WORKING by GetTask polling, whereas PR291 supports it.
learning_observation: The two actual external-seller buyer traces lacked metadata.ask. Their four model decisions encoded unknown price ratios absent from active.q_values, so strategy selection used balanced fallback. Loaded policy identity alone does not show learned policy influence or actual RL performance gain.
conclusions: Expanded transaction functionality and evidence protection are strengths; closest expanded peers are291 and296.
Our price bargaining is not shown to dominate: submitted official buyer mean108.33 and seller mean110; actual289 bidirectional price outcomes favor289 in this single sample.
PR288 is stronger in deployment/persisted task state and repeated experiments, which are separate from bargain price.
No defensible seven-opponent win-rate or overall competition rank can be derived from these artifacts and three trades.
